sentences.en: You cannot praise a child enough for doing something well.
sentences.zh: 你再怎么称赞一个孩子做好事都不为过。

sentences.en: People ask you for criticism, but they only want praise.
sentences.zh: 人们会向你要批评意见，但他们真正想要的是赞美。

sentences.en: No matter what he may do, he will be praised.
sentences.zh: 无论他做什么，都会受到赞扬。
